name: West Route

waypoints.name: Berry Patch Trailhead (Snowgrass Trail #96, access to Snowgrass Flat/Cispus Basin)
Gilbert Peak summit
waypoints.directions: Join Snowgrass Trail #96 and follow it about 4 miles to cutoff Trail #97, which meets the PCT in half a mile; follow the PCT southbound about 2 miles to Cispus Basin. Climb to the saddle at the basin's northeast end, go up an entry gully to the white band and traverse it at about 7,500 ft to the notch behind the black prow, then take the goat path east across two gullies to the saddle south of Goat Citadel and up the ridge to the summit.

approach: Drive to the Berry Patch or Snowgrass Flat Trailhead (Chambers Lake area) off Forest Road 21/2150 on the west side of the Goat Rocks: turn east onto FR 21, continue about 13 miles, turn at the Snowgrass Trail/Chambers Lake sign onto FR 2150, then follow signs to the Snowgrass Flat Trailhead (elev. ~4,650 ft). Hike Trail #96 (Snowgrass) roughly 4 miles and ~2,000 ft of gain along Goat Creek toward Snowgrass Flats, a large subalpine meadow that is closed to camping (use the established sites below it); from there reach the PCT (via Trail #96 or the cutoff Trail #97) and follow it southbound (heading east) about 2 miles to Cispus Basin, which has an established camp in the trees just above the PCT's Cispus River crossing. Climb to the saddle at the basin's northeast end, then scramble east across the Goat Ledges/Goat Ribs traverse toward Gilbert Peak (often combined with Old Snowy Mountain and Ives Peak in one traverse day).
